title: This Quiz Gets Harder Every Question
hook: Getting them all right means elite memory.
script:
Getting them all right means elite memory.
Question 1: Which river is the longest in the world?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is B: Nile River.
Question 2: How many continents are there on Earth?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is C: 7.
Question 3: What gas do plants absorb from the atmosphere for photosynthesis?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is C: Carbon Dioxide.
If you got the first three right, like the video right now.
Question 4: Which actor played the role of Tony Stark/Iron Man in the Marvel Cinematic Universe?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is C: Robert Downey Jr..
Question 5: Which is the only flying mammal?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is B: Bat.
Score check: comment SHARP if you are still perfect, RUSTY if you already missed one.
Question 6: How many bones does a shark have?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is D: Zero.
Question 7: Which language has the most native speakers?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is C: Mandarin.
Are you ready for the last question?
Don't forget to follow and comment your score to be on the weekly leaderboard of the top performers.
Question 8: How much does the Eiffel Tower grow in summer?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is C: 15 cm.
Question 9: Which fruit has more vitamin C than an orange?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is C: Kiwi.
Bonus: double or nothing - keep your score in your head and beat it on the next quiz.
Comment your score out of 9, and follow for a new quiz every day.

items.question: What gas do plants absorb from the atmosphere for photosynthesis?
